sql: select x.scenario_key, (select string_agg('[' || (e->>'turn') || '] ' || (e->>'who') || ': ' || left(replace(e->>'text', E'\n', ' '), 700), ' ## ') from jsonb_array_elements(x.transcript) e where coalesce(e->>'kind','') not in ('image','video','document','legenda')) as t from public.ai_sim_results x where x.run_id = '293482d7-370e-4ded-97c7-0f7065599b32' and x.scenario_key in ('feriado','remarcar_visita')
